[ASSISTANT_CREATED] **Peanut Butter Fudge**: Add 2-3 tablespoons of creamy peanut butter and 1/2 cup of peanut butter chips or chopped peanuts.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] **Caramel Fudge**: Stir in 1-2 tablespoons of caramel sauce and add 1/2 cup of chopped caramel-filled chocolate chips or caramel-coated nuts.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] **Nutty Fudge**: Add 1/2 cup of chopped nuts and stir in 1-2 tablespoons of nut butter.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] **Minty Fudge**: Add 1-2 teaspoons of peppermint extract and stir in 1/4 cup of crushed candy canes.
